rationale: Logistic regression was selected with settings {'model__C': 1}. It achieved mean CV F1 0.4701 (SD 0.0527), compared with the best tree's mean F1 0.3985 (SD 0.0487). The stronger average score supports the choice, although fold variation is slightly higher. Out-of-fold predictions include 566 false negatives. Recall was 0.2157 for Established customers and 0.7816 for New customers, so this difference is considered before testing. Logistic regression is also a relatively simple model. This supports the choice among the tested candidates, but does not establish deployment readiness.
